svg.aria-label: Most common owner complaints about portable power stations, ranked qualitatively

g.text: What power-station owners complain about most (recent 1–3★ reviews and owner threads)
Occasional
Common
Very common
Fan noise while charging or under load
Fast charging = loud fans. Every brand's app has a slower "quiet" charge mode; use it overnight. Bluetti EB3A/AC70 fan pulses are the most-cited.
Heavier than the photos suggest
1 kWh units are 25–30 lb; 2 kWh are 40–55 lb; 4 kWh are 100–130 lb and need the wheels. "Portable" is relative.
Idle / phantom drain when left switched on
Inverters draw power just being on; some big units lose several percent a day. Turn AC off when not in use; the F3800 Plus drew specific complaints.
App account required; firmware only via app
EcoFlow in particular. The units work without the app, but updates and some settings don't.
Surge trips: fridge, sump pump, coffee maker
Motors and heating elements spike on start-up. Check the surge rating, not just continuous watts; 1,000 W units struggle with sump pumps.
Customer service and warranty turnaround
Bluetti draws the most (tickets open for months); Anker the fewest. Buying through Amazon adds the return window as a first line.
Confusing charge settings; slower than advertised
Headline charge times need the "fast" mode enabled and a 15–20 A circuit; default modes are slower on purpose.
Safety worries after the EcoFlow recall
25,030 units, six fires, firmware fix (Oct 2025). Not the DELTA 3 line. Keep firmware current on any brand; charge on a hard surface, never in a hot car.
Qualitative ranking of themes across recent Amazon 1–3★ reviews and Reddit / forum owner threads for the stations in this guide — a tally, not a survey.
